entry_conditions: Each selected target must have an explicit deterministic owner surface such as source_log_path, exact issue/pr ref, or canonical contract owner.
Expected values must be fully derived before apply; blank issue_* or pr_* fields remain blank rather than inferred.
Only items classified as semantic=replayable may enter remediation-manifest or apply.
Any selected block, manual, or reconciliation finding must stop the mixed batch until the batch is split or corrected.

allowed_actions: Derive expected labels, development linkage, parent refs, write-back targets, and canonical body shape
Fetch live GitHub state or retained live artifact
Classify each finding by family and semantic
Emit bounded manifest rows for replayable findings only
Record exact target refs, expected values, observed values, and intended mutations
Link downstream apply and verify artifact paths
Retain before/after artifacts and per-item apply results
Backfill deterministic labels or close-link rows only when already derived
Re-fetch the same target set from live state
Compare against the same expected deterministic values
Emit per-item convergence status and final gate decision

allowed_targets: Canonical body rewrite from approved source
forbidden_targets: Guessing blank issue_* or pr_* fields
Adding mutations not declared in the remediation manifest
apply_contract.allow_apply_decision: A batch may proceed only when every selected item is replayable, fully derived, and bounded to explicit manifest rows.

required_checks: Fetch the same target objects mutated by apply
Compare against the exact same expected deterministic values used during planning
Confirm intended live surfaces converged without creating new drift
post_apply_verify.pass_condition: All selected replayable targets converge exactly to expected deterministic values and all required artifacts are retained.

stop_rules.when: Any replayable target still differs from expected values after apply.
stop_rules.required_follow_up: Retain verify output and open a new remediation cycle instead of silently re-editing live state.

stop_rules.when: Apply fixed one surface but introduced unexpected drift on another deterministic surface.
stop_rules.required_follow_up: Treat the result as a fresh audit finding and classify it again before any new mutation.

stop_rules.when: Before/after/apply artifacts are incomplete or inconsistent with the manifest.
stop_rules.required_follow_up: Do not mark convergence; regenerate evidence or rerun the bounded cycle.
